text: Grandma it's me. I'm in trouble, I got arrested after a car accident and they took my phone. Please don't tell Mom and Dad. My lawyer says I need $2,000 for bail today. Can you get Target gift cards and send me pictures of the backs? Please hurry
notes: Classic jail/bail story: secrecy ('don't tell Mom'), urgency, gift-card payment, unknown number, no name used.
